name: Max reasoning effort (temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95)
description: Results produced with reasoning effort set to max, temperature 1.0, and top-p 0.95, as stated in the Kimi K3.1 Pro model card.

name: 0-shot
description: No in-context exemplars. Used for TruthfulQA (MC2), IFEval, and some MMLU, HumanEval, and WinoGrande reports.

name: 0-shot CoT
description: Zero-shot with chain-of-thought prompting. Used for GPQA Diamond, AIME 2025, MATH-500 (reasoning-model convention), and MMLU-Pro (0-shot CoT providers, e.g. Gemini per the TIGER-Lab note).

name: 3-shot
description: Three exemplars, answer-only. Used for MBPP (standard) and LiveCodeBench 'Pass@1' (DeepSeek convention).

name: 3-shot CoT
description: Three exemplars with chain-of-thought. Used for BBH (standard, official cot-prompts) and LiveCodeBench 'Pass@1-COT' (DeepSeek convention).

name: 4-shot
description: Four exemplars. Used for MATH-500 / MATH final-answer EM (DeepSeek convention).

name: 4-shot CoT
description: Four exemplars with chain-of-thought. Reserved for sources that report MATH-family scores this way.

name: 5-shot
description: Five exemplars. Used for MMLU (standard) and WinoGrande (standard).

name: 5-shot CoT
description: Five exemplars with chain-of-thought. Used for MMLU-Pro (paper and official leaderboard standard).

name: pass@1
description: Single-attempt functional correctness where the shot count is undefined by the source (agentic scaffold runs). Used for SWE-bench Verified.

name: pass^1
description: First-attempt task success (official tau2-bench notation, verified on taubench.com). Used for tau2-bench.

name: with thinking
description: Reasoning mode / high effort enabled. Used for ARC-AGI-2 leaderboard entries labeled e.g. 'Grok 4 (Thinking)'.

name: no thinking
description: Reasoning mode disabled. Used for ARC-AGI-2 no-thinking entries.

name: 128k context
description: Long-context evaluation at 128K tokens. Used for RULER. Other lengths (4k/8k/16k/32k/64k context) are added by data PR when a Score needs them.
